description: This file implements various state handling classes and methods for a lifecycle management system within the WPEFramework plugin. It includes state transition logic such as loading, initializing, pausing, resuming, hibernating, and terminating an application, utilizing external handlers and synchronization primitives.

classes.name: UnloadedState
classes.description: Represents the unloaded state of the application lifecycle, with a handle method that currently always returns true.

classes.name: LoadingState
classes.description: Represents the loading state, responsible for generating a new application instance ID and signaling readiness.

classes.name: InitializingState
classes.description: Handles the initialization process, including starting the runtime manager with launch parameters.

classes.name: PausedState
classes.description: Manages the paused state, handling transitions based on current lifecycle state, including enabling display rendering.

classes.name: ActiveState
classes.description: Represents the active state, ensuring the render is ready before proceeding.

classes.name: SuspendedState
classes.description: Handles suspension and hibernation, including waking and display management.

classes.name: HibernatedState
classes.description: Manages the hibernated state, invoking hibernate on the runtime manager.

classes.name: TerminatingState
classes.description: Handles application termination, either forcefully or gracefully, and waits for termination to complete.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Performs state-specific handling logic, such as starting, suspending, resuming, or terminating the application.
